project.name: Xanthoria parietina mycobiont RNAseq
project.shortDesc: Transcriptomic data from the culture of Xanthoria parietina mycobiont grown on solid 99:1 BMM:MEYE media
project.longDesc: The culture was of Xanthoria parietina mycobiont was grown on nitrocellulose filters and incubated on 2% agar plates with BMM:MEYE 99:1 medium. The cultures were harvested at 2, 9, 21, and 42 days post inoculation; each time point had three replicates. The cultures were snap-frozen in liquid nitrogen and RNA was extracted using an RNeasy Plant Mini Kit. Total RNA was sequenced on an Illumina HiSeq2500 platform to PE150 data

project.name: Gargy-2019_RNAseq
project.shortDesc: RNA-seq of G. argyrea Gargy_04 and Gargy_11
project.longDesc:
RNA sequencing results of Glycine argyrea accessions Gargy_04 and Gargy_11. 
Sequencing results provided by Novogene on 01/2020: Illumina Novaseq PE 150 60 million reads (=18Gb raw data/sample).
Samples are from 3 independent inoculation experiments (3 Reps). Two G. argyrea genotypes, Gargy_11 (resistant) and Gargy_04 (susceptible) were inoculated with Phakopsora pachyrhizi PPUFV02 or Mock-inoculated. Leaf samples were harvested at 36 hours after inoculation and 8 days after inoculation. Total of samples: 23 (2 genotypes x 2 treatments x 2 time points x 3 reps = 24 samples, minus time point 8 dai is missing for genotype Gargy_11 inoc on Rep2 --> total 23 samples).
Note: RNA samples sequenced correspond to the same samples of the 2019 IsoSeq experiment.
